_meta.topic: Free food distributions — Long Beach, CA
_meta.source: City of Long Beach food-distribution guide (https://www.longbeach.gov/globalassets/health/media-library/documents/healthy-living/individual/nutrition-and-physical-activity/long-beach-food-distributions---all-languages) + Long Beach subset of the Los Angeles Regional Food Bank pantry locator.
_meta.note: Generated by prepare-longbeach-food.mjs. PDF sites geocoded via Mapbox (LA-locator sites carry their own coords). Weekly/monthly native recurrence, one rolling doc per pattern. 3 sites present in both sources are kept only from the PDF. Read longbeach-geocode-review.txt before seeding.

items.title: Salvation Army — Long Beach Red Shield Services — Free Food Distribution
items.description: Free food distribution at Salvation Army — Long Beach Red Shield Services. Schedule: Mon–Wed, Fri 9:15 AM–11:45 AM. Bring photo ID, proof of residency, and proof of low-income status. Individuals can attend once every 2 weeks. Call (562) 247-3528 to confirm before you go — hours change with holidays and weather, and distributions often end early when supplies run out. Source: City of Long Beach food-distribution guide.
items.locationName: Salvation Army — Long Beach Red Shield Services
items.address: 3092 Long Beach Blvd., Long Beach, CA 90807
items.sourceOrg: City of Long Beach Dept. of Health & Human Services
